<entry id="Q01241">
<head-word>פָּסוּל</head-word>
<head-word>פְּסוּלָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (פָּסַל; cmp. פגם) 
<italic>defective, blemished, unfit, disqualified</italic>, opp. כשר.</definition>
<notes> Zeb. II, 1 נשפך ואספו פ' … if the blood was spilt over the pavement, and one collects it again, it is unfit for sprinkling. Ib. 3, v. פִּיגּוּל. Ḥull. I, 4 שחיטתו פ' his slaughtering act is illegitimate (the animal so slaughtered is forbidden to be eaten). Ib. כשר בשחיטה פ' במליקה וכ' what is right in slaughtering, is illegal in pinching (the neck) &c. Zeb. III, 2 קבל הכשר ונתן לפ' if a person qualified for the service received the blood and handed it to one disqualified. Gen. R. s. 70 אליעזר פְּסוּל הבית היה וכ' Eliezer was the disqualified (servant) of the house, and yet it is written &c. Kidd. IV, 6 פ' מן הכהונה לעולם is forever unfit for priesthood (his female descendants are forbidden to priests); בתו פ' לכהונה his daughter cannot marry a priest; a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. פְּסוּלִים, פְּסוּלִין; פְּסוּלֹות</plural-form>. Snh. III, 3 אלו הן הפ' the following are disqualified (for judges or witnesses). Gitt. IX, 4 שלשה גטין פ' three kinds of letters of divorce are invalid. Zeb. III, 1 כל הפ' ששחטו וכ' if any of those unfit for priestly service did the slaughtering, his act is legal. Kidd. 77
<sup>a</sup> כל שנולדה מן הפ' born of disqualified parents; מאי פ' אילימא פ' לו what do you mean by ‘disqualified’? Do you mean disqualified (forbidden in marriage) to him (the father)? Ib. פְּסוּלֵי כהונה persons disqualified for the priesthood (degraded priests). Y. ib. III, 64
<sup>c</sup> כשרין הוזהרו על הפ' וכ' qualified persons are cautioned (in the Law) not to 
<pgbrk id="pg1193" />marry disqualified women, … but qualified women are not forbidden to marry disqualified men. Shek. VII, 7 הקינין הפ' consecrated birds that became disqualified (or unavailable) for sacrificial purposes. Bekh. V, 1, a. fr. פסולי המוקדשים dedicated objects which became unfit for the purpose to which they were dedicated; a. v. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="Q01242">
<head-word>פְּסוּל</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced.) 
<italic>blemish, disqualification.</italic></definition>
<notes> Yoma I, 1 שמא יארע בו פ' because something might happen that would disqualify him for the service of the day. Pes. 56
<sup>a</sup> שמא … יש במיטתי פ' is there perhaps, which God forbid, a blemish in my couch (an unworthy person among my descendants)? Tosef. Mikv. I, 19, a. e. מקוה פְּסוּלֹו בעצמו a bath (that has become unfit for ritual purposes) has its unfitness in itself; בן גרושה … שפסולו באחרים whereas the son of a divorced woman (married to a priest) owes his disqualification to others (his parents). Ib. פסולו ביחיד his (its) unfitness is caused by a single person; פסולו בבית דין by a court; Mikv. III, 1 לעולם הוא בפסולו וכ' it remains in its condition of unfitness until &c. Zeb. VIII, 3 אין מביאין קדשים לבית הפ' we must not wittingly cause sacred meat to be brought to the place where the unfit things are burnt. Ib. X, 7 שלא יביא … לידי פ' for one must not cause T’rumah to become unfit; a. v. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<head-word>פְּסוֹלֶת</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>

<sense>

<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>chips, stone-dust</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Shek. V, 49
<sup>a</sup> bot. פסל לך שתהא הפ' שלך ‘hew for thyself’ (Ex. XXXIV, 1) that the chips be thine; Ned. 38
<sup>a</sup> פְּסוֹלְתָּן שלך their chips be thine. Ib.; Y. Shek. l. c. מפ' של לוחית העשיר וכ' Moses became rich from the chips of the tablets; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>

<italic>refuse, base metal, worthless matter</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 138
<sup>a</sup> נוטל אוכל ומניח את הפ' he takes up what is eatable, and leaves the refuse. Ib. פ' למעלה וכ' (when you sift,) the refuse is on the surface, and the eatable peas are at the bottom. Num. R. s. 16 שהפ' שלה משובח וכ' the inferior soil of Palestine was much superior to the best of &c. Ib. שכן התגרין מראין את הפ' וכ' so the merchants show the inferior goods first &c. Y. Gitt. I, 43
<sup>d</sup> top (ref. to מקצות, I Kings XII, 31) מן הקוצים שבעם ומן הפ' וכ' of the thorns among the people, the refuse &c. Sifré Deut. 312 יצא ממנו פ' (sub. זרע) unworthy offspring came from him; Gen. R. s. 68; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. פְּסוֹלֹות</plural-form>. Num. R. s. 7, beg., v. סָנַן.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="Q01249">
<head-word>פָּסוּק</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (פָּסַק) [
<italic>division, interval</italic>,] 
<italic>Biblical verse</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yeb. 16
<sup>b</sup> פ' זה שר וכ' this verse (Ps. XXXVII, 25) has been said by the archangel of the world. Snh. 99
<sup>a</sup> אפי' אמר … חוץ מפ' זה even if one says, the whole Torah is from heaven, except this one verse; a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. פְּסוּקִים, פְּסוּקִין</plural-form>. Taan. 27
<sup>b</sup> הקורא בתורה … משלשה פ' he who reads from the Law, must read no less than three verses. Meg. 22
<sup>a</sup> אין מתחילין בפרשה … פ' in reading from a section of the Torah you must not begin with less than three verses, i.e. you must begin with at least the fourth verse from the beginning of the section. Kidd. 30
<sup>a</sup> חמשת … פ' הוו פְסוּקֵי ספר תורה וכ' the number of verses of the Book of the Law (Pentateuch) is 5888; ib. והתגלח (חציין) של פ' the verse beginning with 
<italic>v’hithgallaḥ</italic> (Lev. XIII, 33) marks the middle of the verses of the Pentateuch; Yalk. Deut. 855 (needs emend.). Lev. R. s. 6 בארי לא נתנבא אלא שני פ' וכ' Beeri prophesied no more than two verses, … and they were attached to the book of Isaiah; a. v. fr.—[Sifré Num. 131 מתחת פסוקין, v. פְּסִיקְיָא.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="Q01250">
<head-word>פְּסוּקָא</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same.</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> Taan. 27
<sup>b</sup> כל פ' דלא פסקיה וכ' you must not divide a verse which Moses has not divided, i.e. in reading you must not stop in the middle of a verse; Meg. 22
<sup>a</sup>. Ib. 25
<sup>a</sup> דאמר פ' פ' וכ' (Ms. M. פ' only) when he recites each verse (of the Sh’mʿa) and repeats it; Ber. 33
<sup>b</sup> פְּסוּקָה פסוקה. Ḥag. 15
<sup>a</sup> sq. אמר ליה פסוק לי פְּסוּקָךְ he said to a child, tell me thy verse; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. פְּסוּקִין, פְּסוּקַיָּא, פְּסוּקֵי</plural-form>. Y. M. Kat. III, 83
<sup>b</sup> bot. (expl. דלתות, Jer. XXXVI, 23) תלת ארבע פ' (ed. Krot. פְּסִיקָן) three or four verses. Kidd. 30
<sup>a</sup> פ' מיהא ליתו וכ' let us bring up the Torah and count the verses; בפ' נמי לא בקיאינן we (Babylonians) know not even the division of verses. Ib. במערבא פסקי ליה … תלתא פ' in Palestine they divided this verse (Ex. XIX, 9) into three verses; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="Q01256">
<head-word>פֶּסַח</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced. wds.) 
<italic>Passover festival</italic>; (sub. זבח) 
<italic>Passover sacrifice, Passover meal</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. V, 1 (58
<sup>a</sup>) חל ערב פ' וכ' (Mish. ed. ערבי פסחים; Y. ed. ערב פסחים) if the eve of Passover occurred on a Friday. Ib. 2 הפ' ששחטו וכ' if they slaughtered a Passover lamb not as such. Ib. IX, 9 חבורה שאבדה פִסְחָהּ a party that lost its dedicated Passover lamb. Ib. 5, a. fr. פ' מצרים, פ' דורות, v. דּוֹר. Ib. 3, a. fr. פ' ראשון the first Passover, i.e. that celebrated on the fifteenth of Nisan; פ' שני the second (vicarious) Passover, on the eve of the fifteenth of Iyar (Num. IX, 10 sq.); a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. פְּסָחִים</plural-form>. Ib. 10 שתי … שנתערבו פִּסְחֵיהֶן two parties whose Passover sacrifices were mixed up. Ib. X, 6 ונאכל שם … ומן הפ' וכ' that there we may partake of the offerings and the Passover sacrifices &c.; a. fr.—ערבי (ערב) פ', v. supra. Ib. 1; a. fr.—
<italic>P’saḥim</italic>, name of a treatise, of the Order of Moëd, of the Mishnah, Tosefta, Talmud Babli and Y’rushalmi.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<language-key>(b. h. </language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083">פָּשַׂק)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>to separate, part, distribute</italic>,] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to divide, split, interrupt</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Taan. 27
<sup>b</sup>; Meg. 22
<sup>a</sup> פּוֹסֵק the reader divides (one verse), i.e. the first reads two verses and a half, leaving the other half to be read by his successor. Ib. לא התיר לי לִפְסוֹק וכ' he permitted me to cut a verse in two only in teaching the school children. Ib. 31
<sup>b</sup> במשנה תורה פוסק the chapter in Deuteronomy containing the curses (Deut. XXVIII, 15—69) may be divided (to be read by two or more); a. fr.—[Gen. R. s. 10 כיון שפסקה; Yalk. ib. 16 שפוסקה, v. פָּתַק.]—Part. pass. פָּסוּק; f. פְּסוּקָה. Ḥull. III, 3 פְּסוּקַת הגרגרת, v. גַּרְגֶּרֶת.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (denom. of פָּסוּק) 
<italic>to recite a verse</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥag. 15
<sup>a</sup>, sq. פְּסוֹק לי פְּסוּקְךָ (interch. with Chald. פסוק לי פסוקיך) recite to me thy Bible verse (recently learned).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (cmp. חָתַךְ, גָּזַר) 
<italic>to apportion, assign; to provide; to promise, agree</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. 65
<sup>a</sup> אין פּוֹסְקִין יינות לאשה in decreeing alimentation for a woman we do not provide for wine. Ib. כך תִּפְסְקוּ לבנותיכם so much (and no more) may ye grant to your daughters. Ib. 107
<sup>a</sup> פוסקין מזונות לאשת איש the court assigns alimentation (from the estate) to a deserted wife. Ib. V, 8 לא פ' … אלא וכ' only R. Y. decreed barley as a part of alimentation, because he lived near Edom. Ib. פוסק לעומתן וכ' he must give her &c., v. עוּמָּה. Ib. VI, 2 הפוסק מעות לחתנו if a man agrees to pay a certain amount to his intended son-in-law (on the date of marriage). Ib. 3 פָּסְקָה להכניס … הוא פוסק וכ' if she promises to bring to him one thousand Denars, he must assign to her (as settlement in the K’thubah) fifteen Manehs. Tosef. ib. XIII (XII), 1 אם פָּסְקוּ לה … מה שפסקו פסקו if the court has granted her (alimentation), what they have granted, is granted. Ib. פסקה היא לעצמה (not על עצמה) if she herself has promised (to bring her husband a certain sum, and now her father refuses to give it). Ib. אבה פ' עלי וכ' my father has promised for me; what can I do (if he retracts)?; Keth. XIII, 5. Y. Kidd. IV, 65
<sup>c</sup> top פּוֹסְקֵי צדקה ברבים וכ' those who subscribe to a charity in public and refuse to pay; Taan. 8
<sup>b</sup>; a. v. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to fix a price; to buy on time</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gitt. 58
<sup>a</sup> אפדנו בכל ממון שפוסקין עליו I will redeem him for any price that they may set on him. B. Mets. V, 7 אין פוסקין … עד שיצא השער you dare not fix a price on crops (buy on time), until the market price has been published. Ib. יצא השער פוסקין ואע"פ שאין לזה יש לזה (missing in Y. ed.) when the market price is out, you may buy, for although he (the seller) has no goods as yet, others have. Ib. פוסק עמו על הגדיש, v. גָּדִישׁ; a. v. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—5)</number>
<definition> פ' דברים [
<italic>to split words</italic>,] 
<italic>to argue</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 44
<sup>b</sup> פיסקון שפוסק דברים כלפי מעלה Gabriel is surnamed Pisḳon, because he argues with the Lord.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—6)</number>
<definition> (neut. verb) 
<italic>to be cut off; to cease, be stopped</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sot. IX, 9 משרבו … פסקו המים המרים … הפסיקן when the faithless men became frequent, the application of the waters of jealousy ceased, and it was R. J. ben Z. that abolished them. Ib. 12 פסקו אנשי אמונה the men of faith ceased to exist. Tanḥ. Sh’moth 16 אין אותה מצוה פוֹסֶקֶת מביתו that good deed shall never cease from (being practiced in) his house. Gen. R. s. 52 פסקו העוברים והשבים travellers ceased to pass by; a. v. fr.</notes></sense></senses>

<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to separate, sever connection; to form a partition</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sot. 38
<sup>b</sup> אפי' מחיצה … אינה מַפְסֶקֶת בין וכ' not even an iron wall forms a partition between Israel and his father in heaven (worshippers form a congregation even if separated by a partition); Pes. 85
<sup>b</sup>. Peah. I, 2 ואלו מַפְסִיקִין לפאה the following things form a division of fields with regard to Peah: a brook &c. Ab. Zar. 52
<sup>a</sup> את ה' הענין the word 
<italic>eth</italic> (before 
<italic>ĕlohehem</italic> Deut. XII, 2) divides the subject (so as not to allow an analogy between idolatrous utensils and the idols themselves), v. next w.; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to interrupt; to cause to cease; to leave off; to pause</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. II, 2 בין ויאמר לאמת ויציב לא יַפְסִיק between the last portion of the Sh’mʿa (Num. XV, 37-41) and ‘Ĕmeth V’yatsib’ one must not pause (interrupt the prayer to greet a person &c.). Ib. 14
<sup>a</sup> במגילה מהו שיפסיק may one interrupt one’s self during the reading of the M’gillah? [Ib. also פּוֹסֵק 
<italic>Kal</italic>.] Ib. V, 1. Ex. R. s. 2 עם כל הנביאים ה' מלדבר … לא ה' מימיו with all other prophets the Lord ceased from speaking at times, but with Moses he never ceased. Taan. 30
<sup>a</sup> סעודה המַפְסִיק בה the meal with which one ceases (the last meal before beginning to fast, called סעודה המַפְסֶקֶת). Y. Nidd. I, 49
<sup>c</sup> והִפְסִיקָה שלש עונות and ceased (to have menstruation) for three periods. Meg. III, 6 אין מַפְסִיקִין בקללות וכ' in reading the curses (Lev. XXVI, 14-44; Deut. XXVIII, 15-69) you must not break off, but one person must read the whole &c. Ib. 31
<sup>b</sup> מקום שמפסיקין בשבת וכ' where they leave off reading on Sabbath morning, there they continue in the afternoon &c. Sot. IX, 9, v. supra. Gen. R. s. 52, beg. מה אני מפסיק צדקה מביתי shall I allow charity to cease in my house (to fall into desuetude from want of opportunity)?; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cut sprays off, trim</italic>, v.

<notes /></sense>

<sup>b</sup> ומפסקתה (corr. acc.); Yalk. Is. 266 והיתה … עליה ומְפַסַּקְתָּהּ; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

R. s. 32, end פסקת חייוי דהאי גברא thou cuttest off (shortenest) this man’s (my) life (by divulging my spurious descent); a. fr.—פסיק רישיה ולא ימות ‘let his head be cut off, but let him not die’, a dialectic term for 
<italic>an unavoidable result of an act</italic>. Sabb. 75

<sup>b</sup>, v. infra 
<italic>Af.</italic></notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be interrupted; to cease</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Gen. XLIV, 12 (h. text כִּלָּה). Targ. II Esth. III, 7. Targ. Deut. V, 19; a. fr.—Lev. R. s. 31; Midr. Till. to Ps. XIX; Yalk. ib. 673 (expl. לא נעדר, Zeph. III, 5) לא פַסְקִין they never fail. M. Kat. 4
<sup>a</sup> מיא דלא פּסְקֵי water which never fails. Ib. עבידא דפַסְקָא it often fails. Ib. 18
<sup>b</sup> קלא דלא פָסֵיק a continuous rumor; וכמה קלא דלא פ' how long must a rumor last to be called a continuous rumor? Ib. דלא פ' ביני ביני if it has not ceased at intervals. Gitt. 69
<sup>a</sup> כי היכי דפסקי … לִיפְסוֹק וכ' as this water ceases to run, so may the blood of—stop flowing. Sabb. 30
<sup>b</sup> לא פ' פומיה, v. גִּירְסָא I; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to apportion, assign, bargain, agree, subscribe</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Hor. III, 48
<sup>a</sup> bot. הוה חמי … פ' והוא פסיק לקיבליה he waited to see how much the whole assembly subscribed, and he subscribed an amount equal to the entire subscription; Lev. R. s. 5 כד הוון פַּסְקִין וכ' when all people had subscribed, he &c. Ib. פ' חד ליטרא וכ' subscribed one pound of gold. Keth. 65
<sup>a</sup> פְּסוֹק לי מזוני give me an order for my food; פ' לה he did so. Ib. 63
<sup>a</sup> פסקו ליה וכ' they made arrangements for him for six years (to remain at college). Lev. R. s. 34 אנן פּסְקִינָן פרנה we shall make up the dowry by subscription (v. פְּסַס); Yalk. ib. 665; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—5)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to decide, adjudge</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. I Kings XX, 40. Targ. Job XXXVIII, 10; a. e.—Succ. 29
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. קא פסיק ותני לא שנא וכ' the editor of the Mishnah decides and teaches; i.e. speaks absolutely, drawing no distinction whether &c. Gitt. 86
<sup>b</sup> לא פְסִיקָא ליה it was not decided with him, i.e. he could not state it absolutely; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—6)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to close</italic>; פ' סידרא 
<italic>to close the reading from the Pentateuch, read the Hafṭarah</italic>.</definition>

<xref rid="Q01250">פְּסוּקָא</xref>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>

<italic>to sever, break, burst</italic>.</definition>

<entry id="Q01439">
<head-word>פָּצַע</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> cmp. preced.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to split, crack</italic> or 
<italic>squeeze open; to wound</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. 93
<sup>a</sup> הכני פְּצָעֵנִי על מנת לפטור פטור (if one said to one’s neighbor) strike me, wound me, with the condition that thou be free (from indemnity): he is free. Ib. הכני פצעני על מנת לפטור וכ' (if he said) ‘strike me, wound me’, (and he is aked,) with the condition that I shall be free?, and he answers, yes. Sabb. VII, 2 הפּוֹצֵעַ שני חוטין he who divides off two threads (on the loom). Tosef. ib. VIII (IX), 21 כדי לִפְצוֹעַ וכ' large enough to divide with it two threads (on each side) at a time. Yalk. Gen. 38 פְּצַעְתִּיו, v. פֶּצַע. Sabb. 75
<sup>a</sup> הצד חלזון והפּוֹצְעוֹ he who catches a snail and breaks it open (squeezes it out); Tosef. ib. VIII (IX), 2 לפצעו (corr. acc.). Sabb. l. c. שפְּצָעוֹ מת when he squeezed it out after it was dead. Y. ib. XVII, beg. 16
<sup>a</sup> לִפְצוֹעַ בו אגוזים to open nuts with it. Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. I, 6 פּוֹצְעִין את מוחו וכ' (not פצעין), v. גֶּזֶר; a. fr.—Part. pass. פָּצוּעַ; 
<plural-form>pl. פְּצוּעִים, פְּצוּעִין</plural-form>. Teb. Yom III, 6 זיתים פ' burst olives. Ter. X, 7 פְּצוּעֵי תרומה burst olives set aside for priests’ gifts; a. e.—Esp. פְּצוּעַ דַּכָּא (פְּ' דַּכָּה) 
<italic>one whose testicles are crushed</italic> (forbidden to marry, Deut. XXIII, 2). Yeb. VIII, 1. Ib. 2 איזה פ' ד' כל שנִפְצְעוּ וכ' what is meant by 
<italic>p’tsuʿa dakka</italic>? One whose testicles, one or both, are crushed. Ib. 75
<sup>b</sup> פ' ד' בידי שמים כשר one whose testicles are crushed from a natural cause 
<pgbrk id="pg1206" />(not through human action) is permitted to marry. Ib. (ref. to Deut. l. c.) היינו דקרינן פְּצוּעַ ולא קרינן פְּצִיעַ Ar. it is therefore (to indicate human action) that the text has 
<italic>p’tsuʿa</italic>, (one that has been mashed) and not p’tsiʿa (one who is mashed); [ed. פצוע … הַפָּצוּעַ …, v. Rashi]. Ib. פ' בכולן the expression ‘mashed’ refers to all parts of the genitals.—</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>*2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to divide the ends of a web, fringe</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Men. 40
<sup>b</sup> כיון שפָּצְעוּ בה שלשה (Ms. M. שצבעו, Mss. R. a. K. שבצעו, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) as soon as they had fringed three fingers’ lengths of it.</notes></sense></senses>

<sense>

<sup>b</sup> זית שפִּיצְּעוּ וכ' olives which they opened with unclean hands; Tosef. Toh. X, 11 שפצעו; Sabb. 145
<sup>a</sup> המְפַצֵּעַ בזתיס וכ'; a. e.; v. infra 
<italic>Hif</italic></notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<senses>
<sense>

XXIII, 29) זו הזונה … נִפְצַעַת וכ' that is the adulteress who is wounded with wounds of love, ‘for naught’, without any wound through her husband. Orl. III, 8 נִתְפַּצְּעוּ האגוזים if the nuts (in the mixture) were cracked; Tosef. Ter. V, 10.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>

<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to split</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Shek. VI, beg. 49
<sup>c</sup> מַפְצִיעַ עצים splitting wood. Snh. IX, 6 מַפְצִיעִין את מוחו וכ'; Y. ib. X, 28
<sup>d</sup> bot. ומְפַצְּעִין וכ', v. גֶּזֶר; a. e.</notes></sense>

<italic>to branch off, spread, scatter</italic>.</definition>

<sup>a</sup>, v. פָּצַל; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>
